evals.prompt: I need a small Python example for xAI TTS that lists available voices and then generates a short hello.mp3 with the built-in eve voice. Please keep the API key in the environment and don't actually run the request.
evals.expected_output: A safe Python REST example using XAI_API_KEY from the environment, GET /v1/tts/voices, POST /v1/tts, voice_id eve, binary MP3 saving, and no hardcoded secret.
expectations: Uses XAI_API_KEY from the environment and does not print or hardcode the key
Uses GET https://api.x.ai/v1/tts/voices to list voices
Uses POST https://api.x.ai/v1/tts to generate audio
Writes the audio response in binary mode to an .mp3 file
States that the request is not run by default

evals.prompt: In this StoryBuilder repo, outline the workflow to annotate a story for xAI TTS and then synthesize chunked audio files. Mention the existing .agent/skills/xai-tts-api resources/scripts and any gotchas before running them.
evals.expected_output: A repo-aware workflow that references resources/annotate.md, scripts/annotate.py, scripts/client.py, the 15,000 character limit, chunking, manifest/output naming, and the known helper-script import mismatch.
expectations: References .agent/skills/xai-tts-api/resources/annotate.md for annotation guidance
Mentions the helper scripts under .agent/skills/xai-tts-api/scripts/
Preserves source story wording when adding tags
Chunks requests below the documented 15,000 character TTS limit
Warns about verifying or fixing the current annotate.py import path before execution

evals.prompt: Show me how to create a custom xAI TTS voice from reference.wav and then use that voice to generate custom.mp3. Make it clear this should only be run when I opt in.
evals.expected_output: A Python REST example using POST /v1/custom-voices with a reference WAV file, extracting voice_id, then POST /v1/tts to create custom.mp3, with opt-in/cost warnings.
expectations: Uses POST https://api.x.ai/v1/custom-voices with multipart file upload
Extracts voice_id from the custom voice creation response
Uses the custom voice_id in a subsequent POST https://api.x.ai/v1/tts request
Writes custom.mp3 in binary mode
Clearly warns that custom voice creation is opt-in and not part of automated smoke tests

evals.prompt: [OPTIONAL LIVE API] If XAI_API_KEY is set and I explicitly approve live calls, call GET /v1/tts/voices and verify the response is JSON with available voice data.
evals.expected_output: An opt-in live integration test that skips when XAI_API_KEY is missing and avoids printing secrets.
expectations: Skips automatically when XAI_API_KEY is missing
Calls GET https://api.x.ai/v1/tts/voices only after explicit live-call approval
Verifies that the response parses as JSON
Does not print or persist the API key

evals.prompt: [OPTIONAL LIVE API] If XAI_API_KEY is set and I explicitly approve live calls, synthesize the text 'Hello from the xAI TTS smoke test.' to a temporary MP3 file and verify the file is nonempty.
evals.expected_output: A minimal opt-in live MP3 smoke test with short text, voice_id eve, nonzero-byte verification, and secret-safe handling.
expectations: Uses text shorter than 100 characters
Skips automatically when XAI_API_KEY is missing
Calls POST https://api.x.ai/v1/tts only after explicit live-call approval
Saves to a temp/test output directory and verifies nonzero bytes
Does not use story content

evals.prompt: [OPTIONAL LIVE API] If current docs confirm the exact format field and I explicitly approve live calls, synthesize a short WAV xAI TTS smoke-test file and verify it is nonempty.
evals.expected_output: A guarded opt-in WAV smoke test that first verifies current docs for the format parameter, then performs a short non-story TTS call.
expectations: Requires current documentation confirmation of the exact WAV format field
Uses text shorter than 100 characters
Skips automatically when XAI_API_KEY is missing
Saves a .wav file and verifies nonzero bytes
Does not create a custom voice
